intro: Sembawang Brook is an HDB BTO project in Sembawang. It was launched on 16 June 2026, in the same HDB sales exercise as Sembawang Portico. That official confirmation covers the launch date only. Completion and key-collection dates are unconfirmed; our project file notes that they are generally beyond 2027. A unit count is not in our file, so that field is left blank, as is tenure. Use your HDB documents for typologies and for any later key appointment. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Sembawang Brook renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Sembawang Brook interior
sections.text:
Sembawang is a northern, more spacious heartland town, and a June 2026 BTO here is still years from renovation. That lead time is useful. When HDB issues your approved plan, the interior brief that usually pays off is built-in: a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry or fridge run, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall, with a built-in desk if a common bedroom will be a study. Maison is an interior designer. We specify carpentry, not IKEA-style loose furniture, and we can work from a wide room view or from closer studies of a wardrobe or a kitchen run. No official floor plan is on file, and we will not invent typologies or a typical Sembawang Brook layout.

Sembawang Portico was launched in the same exercise; Sembawang Anchor followed in the November 2026 exercise and is also listed as a Shorter Waiting Time project in our file, which still does not confirm a key date. Do not assume the three estates share typologies or a handover year. We will not invent walking times to Sembawang town or to any MRT station.

Keep the official plan when it is issued. After keys, inspect defects, then apply for the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your plan when you have it. We are not affiliated with HDB.
